product.name: SmartPay Fraud Detection
product.description: A system that analyzes financial transactions to identify potentially fraudulent activity.

patents.summary: A system for detecting fraudulent financial transactions using behavioral analysis.
patents.claims: Claim 1: A computer-implemented method comprising analyzing transaction behavior of a user and determining whether the transaction is potentially fraudulent.

patents.summary: A system for encrypting financial transaction data before transmission.
patents.claims: Claim 1: A method comprising encrypting transaction data before transmitting the transaction data to a remote server.

patents.summary: A system for generating financial risk scores based on historical transaction information.
patents.claims: Claim 1: A computer-implemented method comprising receiving historical transaction information and calculating a risk score based on the historical information.

patents.summary: A system for authenticating users using biometric information.
patents.claims: Claim 1: A method comprising receiving biometric information from a user and authenticating the user based on the biometric information.

patents.summary: A financial monitoring system that identifies unusual transaction patterns.
patents.claims: Claim 1: A method comprising monitoring transaction activity and identifying unusual transaction patterns.
